description: `icacls <file>` output after `vibememory connect` wrote a token file on Windows, and what `doctor` makes of it: the file must be reachable by its owner alone. The check compares every grantee with the current user (`whoami`), never with group names — Windows prints them in its own language (Everyone is «Все» on a Russian system). `path` is what connect passed to icacls, `user` what whoami printed. Provenance `unverified`: the format is Microsoft's documented one; the first real output comes from the GPD (phase W).

cases.output:
C:\Users\alice\.vibememory\tokens\vibebrains\claude-code DESKTOP-1\alice:(F)

Successfully processed 1 files; Failed processing 0 files

cases.note: A file as Windows creates it in the profile: inheritance not cut.
cases.output:
C:\Users\alice\.vibememory\tokens\vibebrains\claude-code NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
                                                             BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
                                                             DESKTOP-1\alice:(I)(F)

Successfully processed 1 files; Failed processing 0 files

cases.note: Group names in the system's language: the check does not know them and does not need to.
cases.output:
C:\Users\alice\.vibememory\tokens\vibebrains\claude-code Все:(R)
                                                             DESKTOP-1\alice:(F)

Успешно обработано файлов: 1; не удалось обработать файлов: 0

C:\Users\Alice Smith\.vibememory\tokens\vibebrains\claude-code DESKTOP-1\Alice Smith:(F)

Successfully processed 1 files; Failed processing 0 files

cases.note: Nothing parsed is not a pass: a file nobody can read is not what connect wrote either.
